parts.topic: open strings as a free built-in tuner

slides.headline: self teach violin tips!! 🎻
slides.sub: today: open strings are a free tuner ✨

slides.headline: open strings ARE a tuner 🥹
slides.sub: G D A E are all perfect 5ths apart, so when you stop a note the open string next to it should ring, not clash. if it sounds muddy something's off honestly. i double check mine with {app} too, it tells me exactly which notes came out flat or sharp

slides.headline: 3rd finger = an octave check 🎻
slides.sub: in first position, 3rd finger on D should match open A an octave up. check it against that constantly, it's just sitting right there

slides.headline: open string, then finger, then listen
slides.sub: not together! back to back. your ear picks up SO much more comparing two sounds than it does guessing at one all on its own

slides.headline: sounds like a chord? not there yet
slides.sub: a perfect interval should basically ring as one sound. any wobble or beating means keep adjusting, don't move on

slides.headline: go check your strings 🎻
slides.sub: ({app} does this same check for you automatically after you record, if you want a second opinion, link in bio)
